summary: Iter 224 (Jun 2026) — REGRESSION-ONLY verification of Google OAuth multi-audience change (added GOOGLE_OAUTH_IOS_CLIENT_ID + iOS native flow wiring). NO regressions detected. Backend POST /api/auth/google contract UNCHANGED after allowed_client_ids set was introduced: empty body -> 422, missing credential -> 422, credential < 10 chars -> 422 (Pydantic min_length), well-formed but bogus JWT -> 401 with detail 'Could not verify Google sign-in'; endpoint not 404/500. Email/password login regression PASS on both web (/login -> /onboarding as Cathy) and mobile (/login -> / as Cathy). Signup pytest creates a fresh TEST_ user and returns 200 + token. Web /login + /signup still render the GIS 'Continue with Google' button (data-testid login-google / signup-google) with the accounts.google.com iframe injected; no console errors, not blank. Mobile /login + /signup still render the 'Continue with Google' button (testID login-google-button / signup-google-button) after the app.json CFBundleURLTypes + iosClientId change; no red screen, no console errors, page not blank. Real Google consent handshake NOT attempted (per agent note; Google blocks automation and iOS native flow only works in a Published/native build).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:598-604 — allowed_client_ids set gracefully filters None values, so absence of GOOGLE_OAUTH_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID does NOT crash the endpoint. Web + iOS clients only are wired today.
server.py:614-616 — audience check is compared AFTER signature/issuer/expiry verification which is the correct order (avoids attackers forging aud on unverified tokens).
The 'short credential returns 422 not 401' behavior is a Pydantic Field(min_length=10) pre-validation and is documented in the test file — intentional and consistent with FastAPI conventions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (web /login + /signup render Google btn + GIS iframe; mobile /login + /signup render Google btn; email login PASS both surfaces)
